metadata.question: Did the inundation region within a 10 km radius around Ingeniero White port, Argentina, increase on March 11, 2025 compared to January 30, 2025?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search strategy**: - Location: Ingeniero White port, Argentina (approximately -38.8°, -62.3°) - Dates: January 30, 2025 and March 11, 2025 - Collection: Sentinel-2 (optical, high resolution for water detection) - Geometry: 10 km radius buffer around port coordinates 2. **Masking strategy**: - Mask clouds to get clear water/inundation area - Use NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) or similar to identify inundation - Calculate inundated pixel count for each date 3. **Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs. Null**: - Valid Zero (A/B): Both dates have valid pixel counts (even if 0 inundated pixels) - Null/Error (C3): Calculation returns NaN or invalid ranges - Empty Collection (C1): No images found for one or both dates - No Valid Pixels (C2): Images exist but 0 pixels remain after cloud masking ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Ingeniero White port location and 10 km radius const portCoords = [-62.3, -38.8]; // [longitude, latitude] const geometry = ee.Geometry.Point(portCoords).buffer(10000); // 10 km radius in meters // Define dates const date1 = '2025-01-30'; const date2 = '2025-03-11'; // Function to process inundation for a given date async function analyzeInundation(dateStr) { const startDate = dateStr; const endDate = ee.Date(dateStr).advance(1, 'day'); // Get Sentinel-2 collection let col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(geometry) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 50)); const colSize = col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Date ${dateStr}: ${colSize} images found`); if (colSize === 0) { return null; // No data } // Composite best image (least cloudy) const img = col.sort('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE').first(); // Calculate NDWI for water detection const ndwi = img.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']); // Green and NIR // Mask clouds using SCL band const cloudMask = img.select('SCL').neq(3).and(img.select('SCL').neq(8)).and(img.select('SCL').neq(9)); const ndwiMasked = ndwi.updateMask(cloudMask); // Threshold for inundation (NDWI > 0.3 indicates water) const inundated = ndwiMasked.gt(0.3); // Count inundated pixels const pixelCount = inundated.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geometry, scale: 10, // Sentinel-2 native resolution maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const inundatedPixels = pixelCount.nd || 0; console.log(`Inundated pixels (${dateStr}): ${inundatedPixels}`); return inundatedPixels; } // Analyze both dates const pixels1 = await analyzeInundation(date1); const pixels2 = await analyzeInundation(date2); // Validate results if (pixels1 === null || pixels2 === null) { console.log('C1: Empty Collection (No images found for one or both dates)'); return; } if (pixels1 === 0 && pixels2 === 0) { console.log(`Inundation Jan 30: 0, Mar 11: 0 pixels`); console.log('B: No increase detected (both dates show no inundation)'); return; } if (pixels1 === undefined || pixels2 === undefined || isNaN(pixels1) || isNaN(pixels2)) { console.log('C3: Calculation Failure (Invalid pixel count)'); return; } // Compare inundation areas console.log(`Inundation comparison:`); console.log(`Jan 30, 2025: ${pixels1} pixels`); console.log(`Mar 11, 2025: ${pixels2} pixels`); if (pixels2 > pixels1) { console.log('A: Yes - Inundation increased on March 11 compared to January 30'); } else { console.log('B: No - Inundation did not increase or decreased on March 11'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
